kcy4334-lgtm-translate-book-arxiv-root.description: Translate an arXiv paper, or any PDF/DOCX/EPUB book, into any language as a printable book. For arXiv papers it reads the LaTeX source, so equations, tables, figures and numbering survive. Parallel sub-agents translate the chunks; output is HTML, DOCX, EPUB and PDF.
